Name: Modest Maps Meadow Farm
Author: InkubusMods
Description:
[b][u][b]::  [/b]OVERVIEW [b]::  [/b][/u][/b]
The Modest meadow Map is a redesigned Ranch Farm, meant to capitalize on the space provided by the vanilla map, while adding a few tweaks here and there for A more clean and OCD-Friendly workspace.

[b][u][b]::  [/b]FEATURES [b]::  [/b][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Large grass field which you [b][u]can grow crops on[/u][/b].
[*]Custom Water brook for nearby refills.
[*]A quaint work yard beside grandpa!
[*]A specialized Enclosed pond for ducks to enjoy.
[/list][u][b][b][u][b]
::  [/b]REQUIREMENTS [b]::  [/b][/u][/b][/b][/u]
[list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]Content Patcher
[*]Yep.[i] That's all.[/i]
[/list]
[b]MANUAL INSTALLATION:[/b]
1. Download the file.
2. Extract the Folder.
3. Put said folder into:
﻿Steam>Steamapps>Common>StardewValley>Mods.
4. Load with SMAPI.
5. Enjoy.

[b]::  KNOWN ISSUES::[/b]
Check Nexus bug reports. If you've found something not there, please post it and I will try to assist.
